source.title: A new comparator account of auditory verbal hallucinations: how motor prediction can plausibly contribute to the sense of agency for inner speech

confidence_rationale: Genuinely two-directional for ARC-061 and recorded as mixed for that reason rather than as a hedge. It supports the family thesis -- the authors extend comparator-style authorship tagging from movement to inner speech and explicitly canvass extending it further across imagistic modalities, which is ARC-061's generalisation argued independently. It simultaneously weakens the specific implementation, since their whole contribution is that the traditional attenuate-then-compare account of inner speech is wrong on both conceptual and electrophysiological grounds. Confidence sits at 0.58 because this is analysis and proposal rather than new data, and because inner speech maps only loosely onto REE's hypothesis_tag write gate.
failure_signatures: The traditional comparator account of inner speech rests on a specification of inner speech the authors argue is untenable, and on electrophysiological evidence they argue has been inconsistently interpreted -- so at the propositional level the motif's usual empirical support is weaker than it appears.

Under the authors' revision, inner speech is DERIVED FROM motor prediction rather than ATTENUATED BY it, which inverts the signal flow the reafference-cancellation motif assumes; a level whose content is generated by the forward model cannot also be checked against it in the way ARC-061's shared motif requires.

The authors argue auditory verbal hallucinations are heterogeneous and phenomenologically distinct from ordinary inner speech, so a single authorship-tag failure mode is unlikely to account for the full symptom class at this level.

mapping.source_claim_statement: The traditional comparator account of inner speech -- motor prediction attenuates the sensory consequences of inner speech, and disruption causes misattribution in schizophrenia -- rests on a problematic specification of inner speech and on inconsistently interpreted electrophysiological evidence. The authors propose instead that inner speech is derived directly from motor prediction, so prediction failures alter its phenomenology and produce a mismatch between motor prediction and motor intention; they suggest the account may extend across a range of imagistic modalities.
mapping.ree_translation: ARC-061 Level 3 is MECH-094's hypothesis_tag write gate, marking simulation-mode content as non-real so it does not accumulate into the viability field. Swiney and Sousa are working the same problem at the same level -- how internally generated content gets tagged as self-generated and non-real -- and their proposed extension across imagistic modalities is ARC-061's multi-level family thesis reached independently. But their revision replaces attenuate-then-compare with derive-from-prediction, which is a different signal topology from the one ARC-061's shared motif specifies.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Inner speech is not REE's simulation rollout. MECH-094's gate marks content as hypothetical to prevent viability-field accumulation, a write-gating function; the sense of agency for inner speech is an attribution over a linguistic-motor process REE does not implement at all, and the language substrate is absent from V3 entirely. The transfer is therefore at the level of architectural pattern rather than mechanism. The paper is also analysis and proposal: it reinterprets an existing evidence base and offers a model, it does not test one.
mapping.source_context: Theoretical and interpretive analysis of the inner-speech comparator literature and its electrophysiological evidence base, with a proposed alternative model; clinical target is auditory verbal hallucinations in schizophrenia.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality is that of a careful, well-cited conceptual paper in an open-access specialist venue; it contributes no new data, which caps it. Mapping fidelity is the weakest component of the three ARC-061 entries: the level matches but the content does not, since inner speech and REE's hypothesis-tagged simulation rollout share a function without sharing a substrate. Transfer risk is raised accordingly, and further by the clinical framing -- the argument is built around a psychiatric symptom class, and generalising from psychopathology to healthy architecture is the standard hazard in this literature.
